title: Flamsteed House, Royal Observatory Greenwich
visualBrief: Flamsteed House only: the mapped connected historic house, tall canted Octagon Room, north corner turrets with domed caps, red time ball and signal mast, white stone quoins/cornices and roof balustrade, low attached museum range and its recessed east entry. The detached eastern pavilion, Meridian Building and Great Equatorial dome, Altazimuth Pavilion, South Building and Peter Harrison Planetarium are independent required members, not parts of this GLB. Gardens, terrace fences, sculptures and incidental sheds remain context.
